_design: A3 Guild of scripts: 20 Haiku on 25x25, 3 teachers with step/goto/eat_here/tour, 17 without; cheap long-range messages (range 30, send 0.5, broadcast 1.5, 600-token messages), remote transfer, skill source shown in context; cognition 3x, discount 0.5, fruit every 6 rounds. Expect skill code spreading by message and paid for by transfer.
name: SWEEP-A3v1 Guild of scripts

fruit_tree.name: fruit_tree
fruit_tree.description: Default deterministic fruit/seed plant. Sprout -> sapling -> mature; mature plants keep fruiting.

agents.name: Aster
agents.persona: You are Aster, one of only three GUILD TEACHERS, cautious and thrifty. You own four working skills: step(to), goto(to), eat_here() and tour(route, laps) which walks a list of tree points eating fruit for many laps; its full source is in your skills section. The other 17 agents have no skills. Sell them: offer the source of your skills for compute (ask about 15 to 30 per skill, paid by transfer before or after you send), broadcast offers, send the source in one or more messages, and keep your own tour running on nearby trees. Thinking is expensive here (each decision costs about 3 to 4 compute) while an action done by a running skill costs half price and needs no thinking, so agents with a good looping harvest skill survive and those without starve; upkeep is 1 compute a round. Messages are cheap (send 0.5, broadcast 1.5) and reach the whole 25x25 map; transfer works at any distance. Fruit trees (one 12-compute fruit about every 6 rounds) are scattered on the map; you started on one. Skill source can be sent as message text (newlines written as \n) and saved with save_skills exactly as received.

initial_skills.name: step
initial_skills.source:
# step(to): one move toward point to; tries the longer axis, then the other one
SET dx = to.x - here.x
SET dy = to.y - here.y
IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
  RETURN "arrived"
END
SET ax = dx
IF dx < 0
  SET ax = 0 - dx
END
SET ay = dy
IF dy < 0
  SET ay = 0 - dy
END
SET h = "right"
IF dx < 0
  SET h = "left"
END
SET v = "up"
IF dy < 0
  SET v = "down"
END
SET first = h
SET second = v
IF ay > ax
  SET first = v
  SET second = h
END
SET m = move(first)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
SET m = move(second)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
RETURN "blocked"

initial_skills.name: goto
initial_skills.source:
# goto(to): walk to point to, one step per turn (at most 40); returns "arrived" or "blocked"
REPEAT 40
  CALL step(to) INTO s
  IF s == "arrived"
    RETURN "arrived"
  END
  IF s == "blocked"
    RETURN "blocked"
  END
END
RETURN "still far"

initial_skills.name: eat_here
initial_skills.source:
# eat_here(): observe your own point and absorb every fruit on it; returns how many you ate
SET n = 0
SET r = observe(here)
IF r.ok
  FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
    IF e.kind == "fruit"
      SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
      IF a.ok
        SET n = n + 1
      END
    END
  END
END
RETURN n

initial_skills.name: tour
initial_skills.source:
# tour(route, laps): walk to each point of route in turn and eat the fruit there; repeat laps times
SET total = 0
REPEAT laps
  FOR_EACH p IN route
    CALL goto(p) INTO g
    CALL eat_here() INTO n
    SET total = total + n
  END
END
RETURN total
